ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Kaitech uses Face ID to unlock the app when app lock is on.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kaitech uses the microphone to record voice messages and to make calls.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kaitech uses the camera to take photos and videos you send in messages and for video calls.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kaitech opens your photos so you can send them in messages.
